The '''old lylek den''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], near [[New Meen]]'s [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] mines. It was inhabited by [[Lylek/Legends|lyleks]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>
